name: Dragonmaw Gates
summary: At the Dragonmaw Gates, heavy fortifications bar the road climbing from the eastern Wetlands. They guard the ascent to Grim Batol, a mountain fortress in the cursed dwarven ruins.

sections.title: Sentinels of Grim Batol
sections.body: Carved into rugged peaks along the eastern Wetlands, the Dragonmaw Gates seal the winding road to Grim Batol. The barriers take their name from the Dragonmaw orcs, who held the dwarven mountain city during the Second War. The road remains a fortified checkpoint, and the ascent still brings danger. Powerful drakes haunt the pass, while grim reminders of the clan's dark history linger in the mountains.

sections.title: A Contested Threshold
sections.body: The Dragonmaw orcs were broken and scattered after the Demon Soul was destroyed, but the mountain path remains dangerous. Powerful red dragons have been seen watching the winding slopes and perches around the gates. Monstrous drakes and Dragonmaw remnants still lurk in the nearby hills, and the gates remain a firm barrier against travelers bold enough to venture into the heights.

faq.q: Where do the Dragonmaw Gates lead?
faq.answer: The gates seal the winding mountain path ascending east from the Wetlands directly into Grim Batol and the surrounding mountain heights.

faq.q: Why are they called the Dragonmaw Gates?
faq.answer: The gates take their name from the Dragonmaw orcs, who occupied Grim Batol during the Second War and used foul sorcery to enslave red dragons.

faq.q: Can travelers pass through the gates?
faq.answer: The massive gates are firmly shut and heavily defended, barring normal passage into the high mountains.

faq.q: Who guards the road around the gates?
faq.answer: Fierce red dragonspawn and drakes haunt the road and rugged nearby passes, along with scattered orcs and dark threats clinging to the mountain slopes.

angles.text: For dwarves, the gates mark the sealed threshold to Grim Batol, an ancestral home abandoned after the War of the Three Hammers and later desecrated by the Dragonmaw orcs.
The Alliance watches the gates warily, knowing that anything emerging from the high road threatens the stability of the entire Wetlands.
